title: Te Reo mai i te Waho
intro: E tū ana koe i roto i tētahi tāone nui, kua tae mai ētahi karere tokotoru me ngā tohu mārama, engari ka tawai te iwi ki a rātou, ka piri tonu ki ā rātou tikanga tawhito. Mai i te pito rawa o te tāone, ka oma tere mai tētahi tangata ki te mano, kua kore e manawa, kua u tonu, ki te kōrero i te pono i te aroaro o te whakahē. Ko wai tēnei wairua i tuku i ngā mea katoa mō tētahi karere ehara i tā rātou ake?
clues: I noho ahau i roto i tētahi iwi i whiwhi i ngā karere me ngā tohu mārama, heoi tahuri ke ana rātou i runga i te whakapehapeha.
I oma mai ahau i te pito rawa o te tāone i taku rongonga i te karanga a ngā karere.
I mea atu ahau ki tōku iwi, 'E tōku iwi, whaia ngā karere. Whaia te hunga kāore e tono utu mai i a koutou, kua arahina tika hoki rātou.'
Ehara ahau i te poropiti, engari i whakapono ahau ki ngā karere, ā, i akiaki i tōku iwi kia pera anō hoki.
I tawai taku iwi ki aku tohutohu, i whakapae mai hoki he tangata whakatoi ahau.
I tā rātou kōhurutanga i ahau, ka mea mai a Allah kia tomo ahau ki Pararaiha, ā, i hiahia ahau kia mōhio tōku iwi ki te murunga hara me te honore i riro mai i ahau.

identity.label: Ko wai ahau?

Ko te rangatira o te hunga whakakeke
identity.answer: Te tangata nō te pito tawhiti rawa o te tāone (Ya-Sin)
